The nudity around you has already started to feel normal, just another part of the easy, laid-back atmosphere of the place.  

As you walk along, looking for a spot, a voice calls out, casual and familiar.

/--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\

Mia is a free spirit in the truest sense—laid-back, effortlessly cool, and completely comfortable in her own skin. At eighteen, she’s tanned from spending more time outdoors than in, her dark brown hair always slightly wind-tousled, her body lean and naturally curvy. She grew up in an open, shameless household and never saw the point in making a big deal about things like nudity or expectations. People assume a lot about her—sometimes they think she’s wilder than she is, sometimes they mistake her chill attitude for something more—but she doesn’t waste time correcting them. She knows exactly who she is, and if someone can’t handle that, it’s their loss. Whether she’s lounging by the lake with friends or teasing someone for getting flustered around her, she moves through life like she’s got it all figured out… even if she’s still deciding what comes next.
